text.en: The pancreas is purely an endocrine gland, since insulin and glucagon are its most well-known products -- in reality, the vast majority of pancreatic tissue is exocrine, secreting digestive enzymes into the gut; the hormone-producing islets of Langerhans are a comparatively small population of specialized cells scattered through an otherwise exocrine organ.
text.et: Pankreas on puhtalt endokriinnääre, kuna insuliin ja glükagoon on selle kõige tuntumad tooted -- tegelikult on valdav enamus pankrease koest eksokriinne, eritades seedeensüüme soolde; hormoone tootvad Langerhansi saarekesed on suhteliselt väike spetsialiseerunud rakkude populatsioon, mis on hajutatud muidu eksokriinses organis.
